summary: Verified frontend-only CSS layout bug fix for the Contact section. Enlarging the #cf-message textarea to 400px no longer stretches the left .contact-cards column. Measured .contact-cards getBoundingClientRect().height before and after enlarging textarea: both 516.90625px (diff=0px). Regression checks: all left cards (Email, Phone, CONNECT WITH ME with 3 social icons, OPEN TO OPPORTUNITIES with Download Resume button) and all right form fields (Name, Email, Subject, Message, Send Message button) render correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Contact section CSS fix (.contact-grid align-items:start, removed height:100% from .contact-cards and flex:1 from .c-open) confirmed working at viewport 1920x800. Cards height stable at 516.9px regardless of textarea height.
